label: Diagram 2.12
caption: Diagram 2.12 Wall type 1 – concrete ground floor
description: The image shows two sections side by side. The left, titled "Diagram 2.12 Wall type 1 – concrete ground floor", is marked "SECTION" at the lower right. It depicts a horizontal slab filled with a speckled concrete pattern, with a trapezoidal void cut into its underside at the centre. A vertical cross-hatched wall rises from the top face of the slab. A label, "Concrete ground floor slab", is centred below the slab. The right diagram, titled "Diagram 2.13 Wall type 1 – ceiling and roof junction", shows a vertical cross-hatched wall interrupted by a zigzag break line, drawn wider at its lower end. At the top, a horizontal member is labelled "Roof", and a leader to the wall's upper edge reads "Flexible closer". A left-hand label, "Mass per unit area of at least 150Kg/m²", points to the wall. At the bottom, a horizontal line is labelled "Ceiling", and two leaders to the junction are labelled "Sealed joints".
